run_sweep_launch: run a sweep to launch domain generalization training jobs across datasets and algorithms
run_sweep_delete_incomplete: run a sweep to delete incomplete training jobs from a previous sweep run
create_JOB_class: create a Job instance with train_args and sweep_output_dir to manage individual training runs
create_make_args_list: create a list of training argument dicts for all dataset, algorithm, and hyperparameter combinations
create_all_test_env_combinations: create all single and paired test environment combinations for a dataset with n environments
